name: csoai-oowm-gateway
displayName: CSOAI OOWM Gateway — one AI in chat to every axis specialist
description: One OOWM/OWEM specialist per GSPC axis, each measuring against its regulatory baseline. This gateway is the single conversational + MCP/A2A surface: it fans any question across the axis specialist clusters, returns each specialist's sovereign signal, and the whole-estate index signal. Measurement, never certification.

oowm_query.description: Ask one AI to all axis specialist clusters — classify the question, return per-axis sovereign signal + estate index.

oowm_clusters.description: List every axis specialist cluster (oowm measurement + owem serving) with its sovereign score.

oowm_index.description: Aggregate sovereign index signal across all measured axis specialists.

oowm_signal.description: Living signal history + forecast of the index (forecast / grow the sovereign signal).

honesty: Measurement, not certification. Each specialist's signal is a real, measured estate surface; UNMEASURED stays honest. No certification, no ranking, no endorsement.
